subject: Altacorp access onboarding — SSO/SCIM/IP allowlist playbook
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@altacorp.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Altacorp access onboarding — SSO & SCIM scope

Hi Grace / Monica,

Thanks for the quick intro call today. Per our discussion, Altacorp is planning to onboard Redwood for inference routing across our internal apps. Security has asked for a short playbook so we can align on SSO, SCIM, IP allowlists, and service account patterns before the pilot. High level asks from our side: 

- SAML IdP metadata requirements and ACS/entity ID we should expect to configure.
- Which SCIM attributes Redwood consumes for provisioning (roles/groups vs. raw attributes).
- Service account model for server-to-server workloads (naming conventions, rotation cadence).
- Preferred approach when our outbound IPs are dynamic (NAT ranges vs. CIDR allowlist / region fallback).
- Any org policy constraints (minimum password/session settings, session timeouts, audit log retention) that must be configured before go-live.

We'd like to schedule a technical handoff next week with your SE and security engineer to lock the spec. Can you share an internal contact list and any preliminary docs? I attached the internal Altacorp security checklist (for your visibility).

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Senior IT Program Manager
Altacorp
[Attachment: altacorp-security-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]
From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Altacorp access onboarding — SSO & SCIM scope

Alex — thanks, and great to meet virtually today. Attaching a short "Access Onboarding Playbook" that covers our typical requirements and a proposed mutual action plan. Key highlights up front:

- SAML: we support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. Minimum required: IdP Entity ID, ACS URL, x509 cert (or metadata file).
- SCIM: we consume /Users and /Groups; required attrs: userName, active, name (givenName/familyName), emails, and optional groups mapping for entitlements.
- Service accounts: recommend one per integration with short-lived keys (90d rotation); we can support automatic rotation via our private deployment if requested.
- IP allowlists: if your NAT ranges are ephemeral, we recommend region-fallback routing and a short-term CIDR allowlist for the pilot.
- Org policies & audit: we expose token-level audit logs and retention options (30/90/365 days).

Next steps I propose:
1) Technical handoff (SE + Security) — pick a 60min slot next week.
2) Altacorp provides IdP metadata + SCIM test account.
3) Redwood returns a tailored playbook and test plan (within 3 business days).

I've looped in Jordan (solutions) to run the technical call and Karthik (security) for the IP/SCIM policy bits. Attaching: altacorp-access-playbook-v1.pdf (playbook + checklist).

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: altacorp-access-playbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 180KB)]

Subject: Re: Altacorp access onboarding — SSO & SCIM scope

Grace / Karthik / Alex — prepping for the technical handoff. A few clarifying questions so we can make the session productive:

1) SAML endpoints: can you confirm the IdP Entity ID and provide the metadata XML? If you support encrypted assertions let us know (our SP supports both; we typically only require signed assertions).

2) SCIM provisioning: are you planning full provisioning (create/update/deactivate) or just group sync? We need a test SCIM user with servicePrincipal scope so we can exercise PATCH attributes.

3) Service accounts: for server-to-server tokens, would you prefer OAuth client credentials or long-lived API keys scoped to a tenant/service? We recommend client credentials with short refresh TTLs for production.

4) IP allowlists: please provide the CIDR blocks (or Cloud NAT ranges) you expect to egress from. If you cannot provide stable ranges, we'll propose an ephemeral certificate-based auth for the pilot.

I'll bring a short runbook to the call showing exactly where to paste metadata, which SCIM attributes we map to entitlements, and a sample ServiceAccount manifest.

Subject: Re: Altacorp access onboarding — SSO & SCIM scope

Jordan / Grace — thanks for the plan. Attached is our IdP metadata and a short export showing the current NAT ranges. Answers inline below: 

1) IdP metadata: attached (altacorp-idp-metadata.xml). We use Entity ID: https://idp.altacorp.com/entity and ACS at https://app.redwood.altacorp.com/saml/acs (both SP- and IdP-initiated supported). We do not encrypt assertions today, only signed.

2) SCIM: we'll do full provisioning. Test account created: scim-test@altacorp.com (password sent via separate secure channel). SCIM base URL: https://scim.altacorp.com/v2. Expected attributes we send: userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type=work], active, externalId. We can map groups -> entitlements on the Redwood side; we will send group membership in the groups array.

3) Service accounts: procurement prefers a single tenant-scoped OAuth client credential for the pilot (rotate client secret every 90 days). If Redwood needs a different pattern we can accommodate. Procurement is copied.

4) IP allowlists: current egress ranges (subject to change): 54.210.0.0/16, 44.192.0.0/16. If these change in production we'll open a change window. For the pilot please accept these CIDRs.

Procurement: we need a short SOW addendum confirming responsibilities (SOC2 evidence access window, logging retention SLA) — happy to sign DocuSign.

Let me know possible slots next Tue/Wed for the 60min handoff.

Regards,
Alex Morgan
Senior IT Program Manager — Altacorp
